extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: Abell 2029 (z=0.0773). Sohn, Geller, Walker, Dell'Antonio, Diaferio & Rines 2019, ApJ 871, 129 ('A redshift catalog of the galaxy cluster A2029'). 4376 spectroscopic redshifts in the A2029 field; 1054 flagged as cluster members (column Mm='Y') by the caustic technique, 3322 non-members. Instrument: MMT/Hectospec (300-fibre MOS, 1 deg diameter field of view) supplemented by SDSS DR12/DR7 spectroscopy and literature redshifts (column r_z gives the source). Selection function: SDSS composite-model r-band photometric targets; the survey is essentially complete for r<20.5 over the central region and becomes progressively incomplete fainter; no colour preselection is applied (the Hectospec targeting is magnitude-limited, not red-sequence selected), which is what makes this catalogue usable for an unbiased sigma(R). Column rmag spans 13.5-22.5. Sky coverage: redshifts extend to ~40 arcmin (~3.6 Mpc projected) from the BCG; 90% lie within ~3.0 Mpc. This is the single best catalogue in this product for building a resolved sigma(R) field. Note the companion star catalogue (table6, 97 rows) was deliberately NOT merged.
